"The world is your oyster"

We're a one-in-five-billion lucky team
summary: Given a landing date and a set duration, our web app compares how much time that a collection of landing sites on the moon is visible to the Sun and the Earth. It addresses the challenge by showing what percentages of the total duration is the landing site is visible to the Sun and the Earth along with showing the relative positions of the Sun and the Earth with our 3d visualization. This is important because the amount of time that the Sun is visible from the moon directly affects how much power can be generated from solar panels and the amount of time that the Earth is visible from the moon.
details:
Given a landing date and set mission duration:

  • Compares how long Earth and Sun are visible at certain landing sites on Moon
  • Users can make their own custom landing sites other than the 8 defaults

Addresses challenge by…

  • Showing percentage of duration that site is visible to Sun -> measure of solar power generation potential
  • Showing relative positions of Sun and Earth  (3D visualization)
  • Plotting position of Earth and Sun above horizon at landing site

Extra stuff:

  • Shows Moon terrain about a landing site
  • Offers a tutorial for inexperienced users
  • Includes an SI bot that clarifies questions regarding lunar landing sites
